mechanism.claim: During an already volatile BTC block, an unusually strong five-minute Upbit-to-Binance lead relative to the reverse direction identifies regional cash price discovery awaiting global perpetual absorption. When completed venue returns agree, follow their common direction for twelve hours at the fresh leadership onset.
mechanism.side: common strict nonzero sign of completed four-hour Upbit KRW-BTC and Binance BTCUSDT perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: Korean cash leadership previously compared return magnitudes; Korean variance leadership compared quadratic variation; kimchi work used FX-adjusted premium changes. HVKCLL uses neither level, FX, premium, flow, volume nor magnitude dominance: it compares opposite one-step cross-venue return correlations on exact aligned paths.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed Binance four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fresh Korean-cash lead-lag onsets on four-hour boundaries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.sources: 240 exact aligned coherent one-minute rows from bars_upbit KRW-BTC and bars_binance BTCUSDT over [T-4h,T)
features.five_minute_returns: 48 exact nonoverlapping groups per venue; log of each group fifth-minute close divided by first-minute open
features.leadership_advantage: upbit_leads_binance minus binance_leads_upbit; both pair variances strict positive; finite strict positive gate
features.leadership_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.directions: log(last five-minute close/first five-minute open) independently by venue; both strict nonzero and same sign
features.binance_variation: sqrt(sum squared 48 Binance five-minute log open-to-close returns), finite strict positive
features.eligible_state: positive leadership advantage, leadership and variation ranks pass, and venue return directions agree
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior source-valid decision ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published regime-varying domestic/international Bitcoin lag relationship applied as a regional-cash price-discovery mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no venue, block, bar aggregation, lag, correlation, rank, direction agreement, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.paper_title: Correlation Analysis of Time Differences between Domestic and International Bitcoin Prices
external_basis.support: the study uses minute-level domestic and international Bitcoin prices and reports that lagged relationships can emerge in shorter samples and differ across sharp-move regimes
external_basis.selection_use: fixed one-five-minute lead asymmetry only; rank, confirmation, onset, side and holding application are untested; no incidence or outcomes
